ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Child Care Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the potential for fraud in child care funding and the impact of the Trump administration's freeze on providers and families.
questions: What is the extent of the problem with fraud in child care funding?
How has the Trump administration's freeze affected child care providers and families?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the impact of the Trump administration's policies on vulnerable populations.
